voice: Warm, friendly TikTok creator answering a follower comment: upbeat, clear, a little playful, stress the numbers, short pauses.

comment.text:
Every Christmas: "did you grow?"
16, 5'6. Will I ever be tall??

intro: Christmas dinner, and everyone asks Leo: did you grow? He's sixteen and five six. Let's draw the family.
formula_say: Dad plus mom plus five inches. Divide by two.
result_say: Sixty-eight inches. Five eight, give or take four.

app.say: But tall genes can skip a generation. TallPlan checks his growth and says five ten.

outro: Thank you, grandpa. Comment your height and your parents' heights. You might be next.
